description: This file provides a repository module for interacting with a Supabase backend for LMS data, including courses, enrollments, assignments, and submissions. It includes functions for listing, retrieving, normalizing, and modifying data related to courses and user enrollments.

methods.name: isSupabaseReady
methods.description: Checks if the Supabase client is configured.

methods.name: arr
methods.description: Normalizes database array fields that might be null.

methods.name: normalizeCourse
methods.description: Converts a database course row into a client-side course model.

methods.name: normalizeAssignment
methods.description: Converts a database assignment row into a client-side assignment model.

methods.name: normalizeSubmission
methods.description: Converts a database submission row into a client-side submission model.

methods.name: getUserId
methods.description: Retrieves the current authenticated user's ID from Supabase session.

methods.name: listCourses
methods.description: Fetches a paginated list of courses with optional search and tag filters.

methods.name: getCourseById
methods.description: Retrieves a specific course by its ID, including syllabus if present.

methods.name: listAssignmentsByCourse
methods.description: Lists assignments for a specific course.

methods.name: submitAssignment
methods.description: Submits an assignment with payload data, marking it as 'submitted'.

methods.name: enroll
methods.description: Enrolls the current user in a specified course.

methods.name: unenroll
methods.description: Removes the current user's enrollment from a specified course.

methods.name: listMyCourses
methods.description: Lists courses in which the current user is enrolled.
